entries.example: 這家公司以客戶需求為導向。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company is driven by customers' needs.
entries.question: 你的工作是以什麼為導向？
entries.questionEnglish: What is your work oriented toward?
entries.answer: 我的工作是以結果為導向。
entries.answerEnglish: My work is results-oriented.

entries.example: 她在一家科技公司做公關。
entries.exampleEnglish: She does PR at a tech company.
entries.question: 你覺得做公關需要什麼能力？
entries.questionEnglish: What skills do you think PR work needs?
entries.answer: 做公關要很會跟人溝通。
entries.answerEnglish: People in PR need to be good at communicating.

entries.example: 這部電影在講中央情報局的故事。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about the CIA.
entries.question: 你看過跟中央情報局有關的電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any movies about the CIA?
entries.answer: 看過，我很喜歡看中央情報局的間諜片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love spy movies about the CIA.

entries.example: 他是錫克教徒，每天都會戴頭巾。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a Sikh and wears a turban every day.
entries.question: 你認識錫克教徒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any Sikhs?
entries.answer: 認識，我以前的同事是錫克教徒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a former colleague of mine is a Sikh.

entries.example: 通訊地址同上，不用再寫一次。
entries.exampleEnglish: The mailing address is the same as above, so no need to write it again.
entries.question: 填表的時候，你常寫「同上」嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you fill in forms, do you often write 'same as above'?
entries.answer: 地址一樣的話，我就寫同上。
entries.answerEnglish: If the address is the same, I just write 'same as above'.

entries.example: 開店之前，成本計算一定要做好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before opening a shop, you have to get the costing right.
entries.question: 你覺得開店最難的是成本計算嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think costing is the hardest part of opening a shop?
entries.answer: 對，成本計算錯了就會賠錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if you get the costing wrong, you lose money.

entries.example: 最後一分鐘，他們終於追平比分。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the last minute, they finally tied the score.
entries.question: 你看過最後一刻追平比分的比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a game where the score was tied at the last moment?
entries.answer: 看過，最後追平的時候大家都在尖叫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, everyone was screaming when they equalized at the end.

entries.example: 政府放寬了外國人的工作規定。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government relaxed the work rules for foreigners.
entries.question: 你希望台灣放寬哪些規定？
entries.questionEnglish: Which rules would you like Taiwan to relax?
entries.answer: 我希望放寬外國人買房子的規定。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like the rules on foreigners buying homes to be relaxed.

entries.english: air freight; airlift; ship by air
entries.example: 這批貨用空運，三天就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shipment is going by air and will arrive in three days.
entries.question: 你寄東西回國用空運還是海運？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send things home by air or by sea?
entries.answer: 我通常用空運，雖然比較貴。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually send things by air, though it's more expensive.

entries.example: 這部電影有很多血腥的畫面。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie has a lot of gory scenes.
entries.question: 為什麼血腥的電影要分級？
entries.questionEnglish: Why are gory films given age ratings?
entries.answer: 因為血腥的畫面不適合小孩看。
entries.answerEnglish: Because gory scenes aren't suitable for children.

entries.example: 一百盧布大概是多少台幣？
entries.exampleEnglish: About how many Taiwan dollars is a hundred roubles?
entries.question: 你用過盧布嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used roubles?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒用過盧布。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never used roubles.

entries.example: 這家餐廳最低消費是一人兩百元。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a minimum charge of NT$200 per person.
entries.question: 你每個月在吃的方面消費多少？
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you spend on food each month?
entries.answer: 我每個月吃的方面大概消費一萬塊。
entries.answerEnglish: I spend about ten thousand dollars a month on food.

entries.example: 我在網路上看了那段新聞影片。
entries.exampleEnglish: I watched that news clip online.
entries.question: 你常在手機上看新聞影片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often watch news videos on your phone?
entries.answer: 常看，新聞影片比文章好懂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, news videos are easier to understand than articles.

entries.example: 梵蒂岡是世界上最小的國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Vatican is the smallest country in the world.
entries.question: 你去過梵蒂岡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to the Vatican?
entries.answer: 去過，我在梵蒂岡看了很多有名的畫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw lots of famous paintings in the Vatican.

entries.example: 聯邦調查局正在調查這個案子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The FBI is investigating this case.
entries.question: 你在哪部電影裡看過聯邦調查局？
entries.questionEnglish: In which movie have you seen the FBI?
entries.answer: 很多美國影集裡都有聯邦調查局。
entries.answerEnglish: Lots of American TV series have the FBI in them.

entries.example: 英文有二十六個字母。
entries.exampleEnglish: English has twenty-six letters.
entries.question: 你的名字有幾個字母？
entries.questionEnglish: How many letters are in your name?
entries.answer: 我的名字有五個字母。
entries.answerEnglish: My name has five letters.

entries.example: 我開車的時候常聽調頻電台。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often listen to FM radio when I drive.
entries.question: 你平常會聽調頻電台嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually listen to FM radio?
entries.answer: 會，我早上會聽調頻的音樂電台。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I listen to an FM music station in the mornings.

entries.example: 克里姆林宮在俄羅斯的莫斯科。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Kremlin is in Moscow, Russia.
entries.question: 你在新聞上常聽到克里姆林宮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hear about the Kremlin in the news?
entries.answer: 常聽到，國際新聞常提到克里姆林宮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, international news often mentions the Kremlin.

entries.example: 面試的時候，他表現得很沉著。
entries.exampleEnglish: He came across as very composed in the interview.
entries.question: 遇到緊急狀況，你能保持沉著嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you stay composed in an emergency?
entries.answer: 我會盡量保持沉著，先深呼吸。
entries.answerEnglish: I try to stay composed and take a deep breath first.

entries.example: 美國太空總署又發射了一顆衛星。
entries.exampleEnglish: NASA has launched another satellite.
entries.question: 你小時候想去美國太空總署工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: As a child, did you want to work at NASA?
entries.answer: 想過，我以前夢想在美國太空總署當太空人。
entries.answerEnglish: I did. I used to dream of being an astronaut at NASA.

entries.example: 我明天最早九點到公司。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow I'll get to the office at nine at the earliest.
entries.question: 你每天最早幾點起床？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the earliest you get up each day?
entries.answer: 我最早六點起床。
entries.answerEnglish: The earliest I get up is six.

entries.example: 這家診所的病歷都電腦化了。
entries.exampleEnglish: All the records at this clinic have been computerized.
entries.question: 你的公司哪些工作已經電腦化了？
entries.questionEnglish: Which tasks at your company have been computerized?
entries.answer: 我們公司的請假流程都電腦化了。
entries.answerEnglish: Our leave requests have all been computerized.

entries.example: 地震以後，紅十字會送來很多物資。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, the Red Cross sent lots of supplies.
entries.question: 你捐過錢給紅十字會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever donated money to the Red Cross?
entries.answer: 捐過，去年我捐了一些錢給紅十字會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I gave some money to the Red Cross last year.

entries.example: 用中文開會對我來說還是有點吃力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Meetings in Chinese are still a bit of a struggle for me.
entries.question: 用中文看新聞對你來說吃力嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is reading the news in Chinese hard going for you?
entries.answer: 有點吃力，很多字我還不會。
entries.answerEnglish: It's a bit of a struggle; there are lots of characters I don't know yet.

entries.example: 他在黨內是有名的強硬派。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a well-known hardliner in the party.
entries.question: 你覺得談判的時候需要強硬派嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think hardliners are needed in negotiations?
entries.answer: 有時候需要，強硬派可以替我們爭取更多。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. Hardliners can win more for our side.

entries.example: 請幫我轉分機二三五。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put me through to extension 235.
entries.question: 你公司的電話有分機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your office phone have an extension?
entries.answer: 有，我的分機是一零八。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my extension is 108.

entries.example: 他當兵的時候住在軍營裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lived in the barracks during his military service.
entries.question: 你參觀過軍營嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited a military camp?
entries.answer: 參觀過，台灣的軍營有時候會開放參觀。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, military camps in Taiwan sometimes open to visitors.

entries.example: 我覺得我們注定會在台北見面。
entries.exampleEnglish: I feel we were destined to meet in Taipei.
entries.question: 你相信命中注定嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in destiny?
entries.answer: 我相信，有些事是注定的。
entries.answerEnglish: I do. Some things are meant to be.

entries.example: 這間實驗室在做最前沿的研究。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lab is doing cutting-edge research.
entries.question: 你對哪個前沿科技有興趣？
entries.questionEnglish: Which cutting-edge technology interests you?
entries.answer: 我對人工智慧這個前沿領域很有興趣。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm very interested in the cutting-edge field of AI.

entries.example: 這個包包是用回收寶特瓶製成的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is made from recycled plastic bottles.
entries.question: 你喜歡用木頭製成的家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like furniture made of wood?
entries.answer: 喜歡，木頭製成的家具很溫暖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, wooden furniture feels warm.

entries.example: 夜市美食的誘惑實在太大了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Night market food is just too tempting.
entries.question: 你抵擋得了甜點的誘惑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you resist the temptation of desserts?
entries.answer: 抵擋不了，蛋糕的誘惑太大了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, cake is far too tempting.

entries.example: 把醬料和麵條拌均勻。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mix the sauce and noodles evenly.
entries.question: 你擦防曬乳會擦得很均勻嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put on sunscreen evenly?
entries.answer: 會，我會盡量擦均勻。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I try to spread it evenly.

entries.example: 這次颱風的威力非常強。
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon is extremely powerful.
entries.question: 你覺得社群媒體的威力大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think social media is powerful?
entries.answer: 很大，社群媒體的威力不能小看。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. The power of social media shouldn't be underestimated.

entries.example: 我六點回家。
entries.exampleEnglish: I go home at six.
entries.question: 你今天幾點回家？
entries.questionEnglish: What time are you going home today?
entries.answer: 我今天七點回家。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm going home at seven today.

entries.example: 週末我們在河岸騎腳踏車。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends we ride bikes along the riverbank.
entries.question: 你喜歡在河岸散步嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking along the riverbank?
entries.answer: 喜歡，晚上在河岸散步很舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's lovely to walk by the river in the evening.

entries.example: 芒果是台灣夏天很常見的水果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mango is a very common summer fruit in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的國家最常見的早餐是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most common breakfast in your country?
entries.answer: 我們最常見的早餐是麵包和咖啡。
entries.answerEnglish: Our most common breakfast is bread and coffee.

entries.example: 我買了一台二手機車。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a used scooter.
entries.question: 你買過二手的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought anything secondhand?
entries.answer: 買過，我的腳踏車是二手的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my bike is secondhand.

entries.example: 她是公司裡最資深的工程師。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's the most senior engineer in the company.
entries.question: 在你的公司，誰最資深？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the most senior person at your company?
entries.answer: 我們部門的經理最資深，做了二十年。
entries.answerEnglish: Our department manager is the most senior; he's been there twenty years.

entries.example: 你直接坐捷運去比較快。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's quicker if you just take the MRT straight there.
entries.question: 下班以後，你會直接回家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go straight home after work?
entries.answer: 會，我通常直接回家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually go straight home.

entries.example: 我沒辦法忍受這麼熱的天氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't stand weather this hot.
entries.question: 你最不能忍受什麼事？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you least put up with?
entries.answer: 我最不能忍受別人遲到。
entries.answerEnglish: What I can least stand is people being late.

entries.example: 我們在規劃下個月的旅行。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're planning next month's trip.
entries.question: 你怎麼規劃週末的時間？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you plan your weekends?
entries.answer: 我會先規劃好要去哪裡玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I plan where I'm going to go first.

entries.example: 下班前要清點收銀機裡的錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before you leave work, you have to count the money in the till.
entries.question: 出國回來，你會清點行李嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you get back from a trip abroad, do you check your luggage?
entries.answer: 會，我會清點一下有沒有少東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether anything is missing.

entries.english: be unemployed; lose one's job; unemployment
entries.example: 他上個月失業了，正在找工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lost his job last month and is looking for work.
entries.question: 你的國家失業的問題嚴重嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is unemployment a serious problem in your country?
entries.answer: 不太嚴重，失業的人不多。
entries.answerEnglish: Not very; not many people are unemployed.

entries.example: 水管破裂了，整條街都停水。
entries.exampleEnglish: A water main burst and the whole street lost its water supply.
entries.question: 你家附近發生過水管破裂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has a water pipe ever burst near your home?
entries.answer: 發生過，水管破裂那天停水一整天。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the day the pipe burst, the water was off all day.

entries.example: 電腦的磁碟空間快滿了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The computer's disk space is almost full.
entries.question: 你的電腦磁碟空間夠用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your computer have enough disk space?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我的磁碟快滿了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, my disk is nearly full.

entries.example: 他打籃球的時候傷到了腳。
entries.exampleEnglish: He hurt his foot playing basketball.
entries.question: 搬重東西的時候，怎麼樣才不會傷到腰？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you lift heavy things without hurting your back?
entries.answer: 要先蹲下來，才不會傷到腰。
entries.answerEnglish: Squat down first so you don't hurt your back.

entries.example: 我需要硬幣才能買飲料。
entries.exampleEnglish: I need coins to buy a drink.
entries.question: 你的皮夾裡常常有很多硬幣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your wallet often full of coins?
entries.answer: 有，我的皮夾裡都是硬幣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my wallet is full of coins.

entries.example: 從捷運站步行五分鐘就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's a five-minute walk from the MRT station.
entries.question: 從你家步行到捷運站要多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long does it take to walk from your home to the MRT station?
entries.answer: 步行大概十分鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: About ten minutes on foot.

entries.example: 寄包裹前，箱子要用膠帶封住。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before you send a parcel, seal the box with tape.
entries.question: 你寄包裹時，怎麼封住箱子？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you seal the box when you send a parcel?
entries.answer: 我用很多膠帶把箱子封住。
entries.answerEnglish: I seal the box with lots of tape.

entries.example: 我今天很開心！
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm really happy today!
entries.question: 你什麼時候最開心？
entries.questionEnglish: When are you happiest?
entries.answer: 我跟朋友吃飯的時候最開心。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm happiest when I'm eating with friends.

entries.example: 這家店的禮盒包裝得很精美。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's gift boxes are beautifully packaged.
entries.question: 你送禮的時候會選精美的包裝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you choose fancy packaging when you give gifts?
entries.answer: 會，精美的包裝看起來比較有心意。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, nice packaging shows more thought.

entries.example: 週末我們去購物中心逛逛吧。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go to the mall this weekend.
entries.question: 你家附近有購物中心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a mall near your home?
entries.answer: 有，走路十分鐘就有一家購物中心。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one a ten-minute walk away.

entries.example: 陽台的角落有一張蜘蛛網。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a spider web in the corner of the balcony.
entries.question: 你家裡常常有蜘蛛網嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there often spider webs in your home?
entries.answer: 陽台上常常有蜘蛛網。
entries.answerEnglish: There often are on the balcony.

entries.example: 小孩子都喜歡吃糖果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Kids all love candy.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼糖果？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of candy do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃水果口味的糖果。
entries.answerEnglish: I like fruit-flavored candy.

entries.example: 冬天的衣服都放在壁櫥裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The winter clothes are all kept in the closet.
entries.question: 你的房間有壁櫥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your room have a closet?
entries.answer: 有，我的房間有一個大壁櫥。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my room has a big closet.

entries.english: specially; on purpose; all the way
entries.example: 他特地從台中來台北看我。
entries.exampleEnglish: He came all the way from Taichung to Taipei just to see me.
entries.question: 你曾經特地去哪裡吃東西？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you ever gone specially to eat something?
entries.answer: 我特地去台南吃牛肉湯。
entries.answerEnglish: I went to Tainan specially for beef soup.

entries.example: 爐子上還在煮湯，小心燙。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's still soup on the stove; careful, it's hot.
entries.question: 你家的爐子是瓦斯的還是電的？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your stove gas or electric?
entries.answer: 我家的爐子是瓦斯的。
entries.answerEnglish: Our stove is gas.

entries.example: 多看書可以增加詞彙。
entries.exampleEnglish: Reading more can expand your vocabulary.
entries.question: 你怎麼學新的中文詞彙？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you learn new Chinese vocabulary?
entries.answer: 我每天用手機背十個新詞彙。
entries.answerEnglish: I memorize ten new words on my phone every day.

entries.example: 他畫了一張示意圖給我看。
entries.exampleEnglish: He drew me a diagram.
entries.question: 你跟別人說路的時候會畫示意圖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you draw a diagram when you give someone directions?
entries.answer: 會，我會畫一張簡單的示意圖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I draw a simple diagram.

entries.example: 我今天的中文作業很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a lot of Chinese homework today.
entries.question: 你的中文老師常給作業嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your Chinese teacher often give homework?
entries.answer: 常給，每天都有作業。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's homework every day.

entries.example: 便利商店的飯糰是三角形的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Convenience store rice balls are triangular.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃三角形的飯糰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like triangle rice balls?
entries.answer: 喜歡，三角形的飯糰很方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, triangle rice balls are convenient.

entries.example: 我們坐電梯上去吧。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's take the elevator up.
entries.question: 你住的地方有電梯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there an elevator where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我們大樓有兩台電梯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our building has two elevators.

entries.example: 這幅畫掛得不太水平。
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting isn't hanging quite level.
entries.question: 你掛畫的時候會注意有沒有水平嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you hang pictures, do you check they're level?
entries.answer: 會，我會用手機確認有沒有水平。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use my phone to check it's level.

entries.example: 我的祖父母住在南部的鄉下。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandparents live in the countryside in the south.
entries.question: 你的祖父母住在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do your grandparents live?
entries.answer: 我的祖父母住在美國德州。
entries.answerEnglish: My grandparents live in Texas.

entries.example: 這張桌子的寬度是八十公分。
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is 80 centimeters wide.
entries.question: 買床之前，你會先量房間的寬度嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Before you buy a bed, do you measure the width of the room?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先量好寬度。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always measure the width first.

entries.example: 請你大聲再說一次。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please say it again, louder.
entries.question: 你在家會大聲唱歌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sing loudly at home?
entries.answer: 會，我洗澡的時候會大聲唱歌。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sing loudly in the shower.

entries.example: 我的皮夾放在包包裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: My wallet is in my bag.
entries.question: 你的皮夾裡有什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's in your wallet?
entries.answer: 我的皮夾裡有悠遊卡和現金。
entries.answerEnglish: My wallet has my EasyCard and some cash.

entries.example: 最理想的是住在公司附近。
entries.exampleEnglish: Ideally, you'd live near your office.
entries.question: 你理想的工作是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your ideal job?
entries.answer: 我理想的工作是可以在家上班。
entries.answerEnglish: My ideal job is one where I can work from home.

entries.example: 我想買一個透明的手機殼。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to buy a clear phone case.
entries.question: 你覺得公司的薪水應該透明嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think company salaries should be transparent?
entries.answer: 我覺得應該透明，這樣比較公平。
entries.answerEnglish: I think they should be transparent; it's fairer.

entries.example: 我外甥今年上小學了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My nephew started elementary school this year.
entries.question: 你有外甥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a nephew on your sister's side?
entries.answer: 有，我有一個外甥，他五歲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a nephew. He's five.

entries.example: 我把掉下來的釦子縫回去了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I sewed the button that fell off back on.
entries.question: 你會自己縫釦子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you sew a button on yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我會自己縫釦子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can sew buttons on myself.

entries.example: 她買了一組成套的碗盤。
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a matching set of bowls and plates.
entries.question: 你家的碗盤是成套的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are your bowls and plates a matching set?
entries.answer: 不是，我家的碗盤都不成套。
entries.answerEnglish: No, none of our dishes match.

entries.example: 冬天很多人得流感。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of people get the flu in winter.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以預防流感？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to prevent the flu?
entries.answer: 打疫苗可以預防流感。
entries.answerEnglish: Getting vaccinated helps prevent the flu.

entries.example: 台北跟我想像中的不太一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is a bit different from what I imagined.
entries.question: 台灣跟你想像中的一樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is Taiwan what you imagined?
entries.answer: 台灣比我想像中更方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan is more convenient than I imagined.

entries.example: 這個飲料的味道很奇怪。
entries.exampleEnglish: This drink tastes strange.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣有什麼奇怪的食物？
entries.questionEnglish: What food in Taiwan do you find strange?
entries.answer: 我覺得皮蛋很奇怪。
entries.answerEnglish: I think century eggs are strange.

entries.example: 陳太太的孫子今年三歲。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mrs. Chen's grandson is three this year.
entries.question: 你的爸媽有孫子了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your parents have a grandson yet?
entries.answer: 有，他們有一個孫子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they have one grandson.

entries.example: 這個英文單字的拼字錯了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This English word is spelled wrong.
entries.question: 你打字的時候常常拼字錯誤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often make spelling mistakes when you type?
entries.answer: 有時候會，手機會幫我改拼字。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. My phone corrects my spelling.

entries.example: 玩這個遊戲要先破壞敵方的塔。
entries.exampleEnglish: In this game you have to destroy the enemy's towers first.
entries.question: 你玩線上遊戲時常被敵方打敗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get beaten by the other side in online games?
entries.answer: 常常，敵方的玩家都比我厲害。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. The players on the other side are all better than me.

entries.example: 沙發要橫著才搬得進門。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sofa has to go in sideways to fit through the door.
entries.question: 你看影片的時候會把手機橫著拿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hold your phone sideways when you watch videos?
entries.answer: 會，我看影片都橫著拿手機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always hold it sideways for videos.

entries.example: 不要把簡單的事情複雜化。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't complicate simple things.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事常被複雜化？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think often gets overcomplicated?
entries.answer: 我覺得辦簽證的流程被複雜化了。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the visa process has been overcomplicated.

entries.example: 這間套房的房租太不合理了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The rent for this studio is completely unreasonable.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些規定很不合理？
entries.questionEnglish: Which rules do you think are unreasonable?
entries.answer: 我覺得公司不能穿短褲很不合理。
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's unreasonable that we can't wear shorts at work.

entries.example: 我的行李太重了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My luggage is too heavy.
entries.question: 你出國的時候帶幾件行李？
entries.questionEnglish: How many bags do you take when you go abroad?
entries.answer: 我通常只帶一件行李。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually take just one bag.

entries.example: 我每天騎機車上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: I ride my scooter to work every day.
entries.question: 你會騎機車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you ride a scooter?
entries.answer: 會，可是我在台北不騎機車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I don't ride one in Taipei.

entries.example: 他真誠地向客人道歉。
entries.exampleEnglish: He sincerely apologized to the customer.
entries.question: 你覺得交朋友時真誠最重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think sincerity matters most in making friends?
entries.answer: 對，我覺得真誠比什麼都重要。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think being sincere matters more than anything.

entries.example: 百貨公司的內衣在打折。
entries.exampleEnglish: Underwear is on sale at the department store.
entries.question: 出國旅行時，你會帶幾件內衣？
entries.questionEnglish: How many pieces of underwear do you pack for a trip abroad?
entries.answer: 我通常帶五件內衣。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually pack five.

entries.english: unload; take off; relieve oneself of
entries.example: 工人正在卸下貨車上的箱子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers are unloading boxes from the truck.
entries.question: 回到家以後，你怎麼卸下一天的壓力？
entries.questionEnglish: When you get home, how do you shed the stress of the day?
entries.answer: 我會泡個澡，卸下一天的壓力。
entries.answerEnglish: I take a bath to shed the day's stress.

entries.example: 這家店的老闆很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The owner of this shop is very friendly.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人親切嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are friendly?
entries.answer: 很親切，我問路時大家都很熱心。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. People are always helpful when I ask for directions.

entries.example: 車子要開了，請扣緊安全帶。
entries.exampleEnglish: The car's about to go; please fasten your seat belt.
entries.question: 坐計程車時，你會扣緊安全帶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you fasten your seat belt in taxis?
entries.answer: 會，我一上車就扣緊安全帶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I buckle up as soon as I get in.

entries.example: 我姪女很喜歡畫畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: My niece loves drawing.
entries.question: 你有姪子或姪女嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any nephews or nieces on your brother's side?
entries.answer: 有，我有一個姪女，今年五歲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a niece who's five.

entries.example: 感冒很容易傳染給別人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Colds spread easily to other people.
entries.question: 怎麼樣可以避免傳染感冒？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid spreading a cold?
entries.answer: 戴口罩可以避免傳染感冒。
entries.answerEnglish: Wearing a mask helps avoid spreading a cold.

entries.example: 垃圾的味道好噁心。
entries.exampleEnglish: The garbage smells disgusting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼食物很噁心？
entries.questionEnglish: What food do you find gross?
entries.answer: 我覺得生的蝦子有點噁心。
entries.answerEnglish: I find raw shrimp a bit gross.

entries.example: 下雨天我們在室內運動。
entries.exampleEnglish: On rainy days we exercise indoors.
entries.question: 你比較喜歡室內還是戶外活動？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡室內活動，不會曬太陽。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer indoor activities; you don't get sunburned.

entries.example: 正午的太陽最大，記得擦防曬。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sun is strongest at midday, so remember your sunscreen.
entries.question: 夏天正午的時候，你會出門嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go out at midday in summer?
entries.answer: 不會，正午太熱了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's too hot at noon.

entries.example: 祝你有個愉快的週末！
entries.exampleEnglish: Have a nice weekend!
entries.question: 你最近有什麼愉快的經驗？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any pleasant experiences lately?
entries.answer: 上週去花蓮玩，非常愉快。
entries.answerEnglish: I went to Hualien last week, and it was really pleasant.

entries.example: 便利商店有賣果凍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Convenience stores sell jelly.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼口味的果凍？
entries.questionEnglish: What flavor of jelly do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃葡萄口味的果凍。
entries.answerEnglish: I like grape jelly.

entries.example: 這家餐廳讓我很失望。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant really disappointed me.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你很失望？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you disappointed?
entries.answer: 朋友不守時會讓我很失望。
entries.answerEnglish: Friends who aren't on time disappoint me.

entries.example: 店員的態度惹惱了客人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The clerk's attitude annoyed the customer.
entries.question: 什麼事最容易惹惱你？
entries.questionEnglish: What annoys you most easily?
entries.answer: 有人插隊最容易惹惱我。
entries.answerEnglish: People cutting in line annoy me the most.

entries.example: 我太粗心，又忘了帶鑰匙。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm so careless; I forgot my keys again.
entries.question: 你是粗心的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a careless person?
entries.answer: 有一點，我常常粗心忘東西。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I often forget things.

entries.example: 可以借我一把剪刀嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Can I borrow a pair of scissors?
entries.question: 你家的剪刀放在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you keep the scissors at home?
entries.answer: 我家的剪刀放在抽屜裡。
entries.answerEnglish: Our scissors are in the drawer.

entries.example: 夏天最惱人的就是蚊子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The most annoying thing about summer is the mosquitoes.
entries.question: 台灣的天氣有什麼惱人的地方？
entries.questionEnglish: What's annoying about the weather in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 夏天又熱又濕，很惱人。
entries.answerEnglish: Summer is hot and humid, which is really annoying.

entries.example: 她的歌聲很圓潤，聽起來很舒服。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her singing voice is full and mellow, really pleasant to listen to.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪位歌手圓潤的聲音？
entries.questionEnglish: Which singer's mellow voice do you like?
entries.answer: 我很喜歡鄧麗君圓潤的聲音。
entries.answerEnglish: I love Teresa Teng's mellow voice.

entries.example: 今天非常熱。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's extremely hot today.
entries.question: 你今天非常忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you very busy today?
entries.answer: 對，我今天非常忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm very busy today.

entries.example: 他講的笑話逗樂了大家。
entries.exampleEnglish: His jokes amused everyone.
entries.question: 你常用什麼方法逗樂朋友？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you usually make your friends laugh?
entries.answer: 我會講冷笑話逗樂朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: I tell corny jokes to amuse my friends.

entries.example: 我爸媽不贊成我搬出去住。
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents don't approve of me moving out.
entries.question: 你不贊成什麼樣的行為？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you disapprove of?
entries.answer: 我不贊成在捷運上大聲講電話。
entries.answerEnglish: I disapprove of talking loudly on the phone on the MRT.

entries.example: 天氣好的時候，我喜歡在戶外跑步。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the weather's nice, I like running outdoors.
entries.question: 你週末喜歡做什麼戶外活動？
entries.questionEnglish: What outdoor activities do you like at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我喜歡爬山這種戶外活動。
entries.answerEnglish: I like outdoor activities like hiking.

entries.example: 她的頭髮天生捲曲。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her hair is naturally curly.
entries.question: 你喜歡直髮還是捲曲的頭髮？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer straight or curly hair?
entries.answer: 我喜歡捲曲的頭髮，很可愛。
entries.answerEnglish: I like curly hair; it's cute.

entries.example: 王太太的孫女很會唱歌。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mrs. Wang's granddaughter sings really well.
entries.question: 你的爸媽有孫女嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your parents have a granddaughter?
entries.answer: 有，他們有兩個孫女。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they have two granddaughters.

entries.example: 我的老闆很幽默。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very funny.
entries.question: 你覺得自己幽默嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're funny?
entries.answer: 我覺得我還滿幽默的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty funny.

entries.example: 護理師幫他的手包上繃帶。
entries.exampleEnglish: The nurse bandaged his hand.
entries.question: 家裡的急救箱應該放什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What should a home first-aid kit have in it?
entries.answer: 應該放繃帶和消毒藥水。
entries.answerEnglish: It should have bandages and antiseptic.

entries.example: 醫生叫我少吃辛辣的食物。
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor told me to eat less spicy food.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃辛辣的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like spicy food?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，越辛辣越好。
entries.answerEnglish: I love it. The spicier the better.

entries.example: 去露營的時候要帶簡單的炊具。
entries.exampleEnglish: Bring some basic cookware when you go camping.
entries.question: 你去露營會帶什麼炊具？
entries.questionEnglish: What cookware do you take camping?
entries.answer: 我會帶卡式爐和小鍋子這些炊具。
entries.answerEnglish: I take cookware like a camping stove and a small pot.

entries.example: 他在墾丁拍了很多水下照片。
entries.exampleEnglish: He took lots of underwater photos in Kenting.
entries.question: 你試過水下攝影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried underwater photography?
entries.answer: 試過，我在綠島拍過水下照片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've taken underwater photos on Green Island.

entries.example: 捷運站外有街頭表演者在唱歌。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a street performer singing outside the MRT station.
entries.question: 你會給街頭表演者錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you give money to street performers?
entries.answer: 會，如果表演者唱得好，我會給一點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the performer is good, I give a little.

entries.example: 面試沒通過，讓他很沮喪。
entries.exampleEnglish: Failing the interview left him very discouraged.
entries.question: 心情沮喪的時候，你會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you're feeling down?
entries.answer: 我心情沮喪的時候會去運動。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm feeling down, I go and exercise.

entries.example: 他開會的時候一直打哈欠。
entries.exampleEnglish: He kept yawning during the meeting.
entries.question: 你什麼時候最常打哈欠？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you yawn the most?
entries.answer: 下午開會的時候我最常打哈欠。
entries.answerEnglish: I yawn most in afternoon meetings.

entries.example: 這隻鳥的鳥嘴是紅色的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bird has a red beak.
entries.question: 你看過鳥嘴很長的鳥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bird with a really long beak?
entries.answer: 看過，我在動物園看過鳥嘴很長的鳥。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw one with a long beak at the zoo.

entries.example: 我好口渴，想喝水。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm so thirsty; I want some water.
entries.question: 你口渴的時候喜歡喝什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to drink when you're thirsty?
entries.answer: 我口渴的時候喜歡喝冰紅茶。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm thirsty, I like iced black tea.

entries.example: 這件事不重要，別擔心。
entries.exampleEnglish: This doesn't matter; don't worry.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼東西不重要？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think doesn't matter?
entries.answer: 我覺得名牌不重要。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think brand names matter.

entries.example: 我很厭惡有人在路上亂丟垃圾。
entries.exampleEnglish: I really can't stand people littering in the street.
entries.question: 你最厭惡什麼行為？
entries.questionEnglish: What behavior do you detest most?
entries.answer: 我最厭惡在捷運上插隊的行為。
entries.answerEnglish: What I detest most is people cutting in line on the MRT.

entries.example: 你的中文發音很標準。
entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese pronunciation is very accurate.
entries.question: 中文的哪個發音對你最難？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese sound is hardest for you?
entries.answer: 我覺得第三聲的發音最難。
entries.answerEnglish: I find the third tone the hardest to pronounce.

entries.example: 這碗湯太鹹了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup is too salty.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃鹹的還是甜的？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer salty or sweet food?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡吃鹹的。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer salty food.

entries.example: 扭到腳以後，腳踝腫脹得很厲害。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the twist, the ankle swelled up badly.
entries.question: 腳扭傷腫脹的時候，應該怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do when a sprained ankle swells up?
entries.answer: 先冰敷，可以減少腫脹。
entries.answerEnglish: Ice it first to reduce the swelling.

entries.example: 塞車了，更糟的是還下大雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're stuck in traffic, and worse still, it's pouring.
entries.question: 下大雨和颱風，哪個更糟？
entries.questionEnglish: Which is worse, heavy rain or a typhoon?
entries.answer: 颱風更糟，連門都不能出。
entries.answerEnglish: A typhoon is worse; you can't even go out.

entries.example: 陳是台灣很常見的姓氏。
entries.exampleEnglish: Chen is a very common surname in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的姓氏在你的國家常見嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your surname common in your country?
entries.answer: 很常見，很多人都是這個姓氏。
entries.answerEnglish: Very common. Lots of people have that surname.

entries.example: 那個店員對客人很不友善。
entries.exampleEnglish: That clerk is very unfriendly to customers.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過不友善的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you met any unfriendly people in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很少，只遇過一次很不友善的司機。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I've only met one really unfriendly driver.

entries.example: 請給我一份護照影本。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give me a copy of your passport.
entries.question: 辦居留證要準備什麼影本？
entries.questionEnglish: What copies do you need to apply for a residence permit?
entries.answer: 要準備護照影本和照片。
entries.answerEnglish: You need a copy of your passport and some photos.

entries.example: 我身高一百七十公分。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm 170 centimeters tall.
entries.question: 你身高多少公分？
entries.questionEnglish: How tall are you in centimeters?
entries.answer: 我一百八十公分。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm 180 centimeters.

entries.example: 昨天下了五十公釐的雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: We had 50 millimeters of rain yesterday.
entries.question: 你的手機大概幾公釐厚？
entries.questionEnglish: About how many millimeters thick is your phone?
entries.answer: 我的手機大概八公釐厚。
entries.answerEnglish: My phone is about 8 millimeters thick.

entries.example: 這個西瓜有五公斤。
entries.exampleEnglish: This watermelon weighs five kilos.
entries.question: 你的行李箱有幾公斤？
entries.questionEnglish: How many kilos is your suitcase?
entries.answer: 我的行李箱有二十公斤。
entries.answerEnglish: My suitcase is 20 kilos.

entries.example: 我們把錢平均分給大家。
entries.exampleEnglish: We split the money evenly among everyone.
entries.question: 跟朋友吃飯時，你們會平均分攤嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you eat out with friends, do you split the bill evenly?
entries.answer: 會，我們通常平均分攤。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we usually split it evenly.

entries.example: 老闆私下跟我談了一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss had a word with me in private.
entries.question: 有問題時，你喜歡私下討論嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When there's a problem, do you prefer to discuss it in private?
entries.answer: 喜歡，私下討論比較自在。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's more comfortable in private.

entries.example: 這張沙發坐起來很舒服。
entries.exampleEnglish: This sofa is very comfortable.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼天氣最舒服？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of weather do you find most comfortable?
entries.answer: 我覺得秋天的天氣最舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: I find autumn weather the most comfortable.

entries.example: 遇到地震要保持冷靜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Stay calm in an earthquake.
entries.question: 你生氣的時候怎麼讓自己冷靜？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you calm yourself down when you're angry?
entries.answer: 我會去散步，讓自己冷靜下來。
entries.answerEnglish: I go for a walk to calm myself down.

entries.example: 去九份的山路很彎曲。
entries.exampleEnglish: The mountain road to Jiufen is very winding.
entries.question: 你騎車走過很彎曲的山路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever ridden along a very winding mountain road?
entries.answer: 走過，去阿里山的路非常彎曲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the road to Alishan is very winding.

entries.example: 他聽到這個消息以後，顯得很惱怒。
entries.exampleEnglish: He looked very irritated after hearing the news.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你感到惱怒？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel irritated?
entries.answer: 說話一直被打斷會讓我很惱怒。
entries.answerEnglish: Being interrupted all the time irritates me.

entries.example: 我用紙板幫貓做了一個窩。
entries.exampleEnglish: I made a bed for my cat out of cardboard.
entries.question: 你會把紙板拿去回收嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle cardboard?
entries.answer: 會，我每週都拿紙板去回收。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take cardboard to recycling every week.

entries.example: 他今天穿了一件條紋襯衫。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's wearing a striped shirt today.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿條紋的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing stripes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多條紋的T恤。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have lots of striped T-shirts.

entries.example: 冬天我喜歡穿針織外套。
entries.exampleEnglish: In winter I like wearing knitted cardigans.
entries.question: 你冬天常穿針織的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear knitwear in winter?
entries.answer: 常穿，針織的衣服很保暖。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. Knitwear is really warm.

entries.example: 我昨天睡太晚，今天眼睛好腫。
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to bed too late last night, and my eyes are so puffy today.
entries.question: 早上起來眼睛很腫，可以怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do if your eyes are puffy in the morning?
entries.answer: 可以冰敷一下，眼睛就不會那麼腫。
entries.answerEnglish: Put something cold on them and they won't be so puffy.

entries.example: 我媽媽很會縫紉，常做衣服。
entries.exampleEnglish: My mom is great at sewing and often makes clothes.
entries.question: 你學過縫紉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever learned to sew?
entries.answer: 學過，我會用縫紉機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can use a sewing machine.

entries.example: 賣假貨騙客人是不道德的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Selling fakes to cheat customers is immoral.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為不道德？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you think is immoral?
entries.answer: 我覺得欺騙老人是不道德的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think cheating elderly people is immoral.

entries.example: 我的美髮師很會剪短髮。
entries.exampleEnglish: My hairdresser is great at short haircuts.
entries.question: 你有固定的美髮師嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a regular hairdresser?
entries.answer: 有，我都找同一位美髮師。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always go to the same hairdresser.

entries.example: 山上有一間荒廢很久的老房子。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an old house up the mountain that has been abandoned for years.
entries.question: 你去過荒廢的地方探險嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever explored an abandoned place?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過一間荒廢的工廠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've explored an abandoned factory.

entries.example: 那個老闆對客人很不誠實。
entries.exampleEnglish: That shop owner is dishonest with customers.
entries.question: 你能接受朋友不誠實嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you accept a friend being dishonest?
entries.answer: 不能，我最討厭不誠實的人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't stand dishonest people.

entries.example: 演唱會門口人太多，場面差點失控。
entries.exampleEnglish: There were so many people at the concert entrance that things nearly got out of control.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候場面容易失控？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you think crowds can easily get out of control?
entries.answer: 跨年人太多的時候，場面容易失控。
entries.answerEnglish: When it's packed on New Year's Eve, things can easily get out of control.

entries.example: 搬家真的很累人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Moving house is really exhausting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事最累人？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you find most tiring?
entries.answer: 我覺得照顧小孩最累人。
entries.answerEnglish: I think looking after kids is the most tiring.

entries.example: 我買了包裝紙來包禮物。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought wrapping paper to wrap the present.
entries.question: 你包禮物喜歡用什麼包裝紙？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of wrapping paper do you like to use for gifts?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用素色的包裝紙。
entries.answerEnglish: I like plain wrapping paper.

entries.example: 巷口有一家藥房。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a pharmacy at the end of the lane.
entries.question: 你家附近有藥房嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a pharmacy near your home?
entries.answer: 有，走路兩分鐘就有一家藥房。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one a two-minute walk away.

entries.example: 他的房間又小又凌亂。
entries.exampleEnglish: His room is small and messy.
entries.question: 你的書桌常常很凌亂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your desk often messy?
entries.answer: 對，我的書桌常常很凌亂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my desk is often a mess.

entries.example: 他對老闆不誠實，結果被開除了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was dishonest with his boss and ended up getting fired.
entries.question: 網路購物時，你遇過不誠實的賣家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever come across a dishonest seller when shopping online?
entries.answer: 遇過一次，那個賣家很不誠實。
entries.answerEnglish: Once. That seller was really dishonest.

entries.example: 這顆維他命有五百毫克。
entries.exampleEnglish: This vitamin tablet is 500 milligrams.
entries.question: 一杯咖啡大概有多少毫克的咖啡因？
entries.questionEnglish: About how many milligrams of caffeine are in a cup of coffee?
entries.answer: 大概有一百毫克的咖啡因。
entries.answerEnglish: About 100 milligrams.

entries.example: 這個兒童節目很有教育性。
entries.exampleEnglish: This children's program is very educational.
entries.question: 你覺得卡通有教育性嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think cartoons are educational?
entries.answer: 有些卡通很有教育性。
entries.answerEnglish: Some cartoons are very educational.

entries.example: 台北一零一是台灣最高的大樓。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei 101 is the tallest building in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你爬過最高的山是哪一座？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the highest mountain you've climbed?
entries.answer: 我爬過最高的山是玉山。
entries.answerEnglish: The highest mountain I've climbed is Yushan.

entries.example: 我在市場買了一盒無花果。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a box of figs at the market.
entries.question: 你吃過新鮮的無花果嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever eaten fresh figs?
entries.answer: 吃過，新鮮的無花果很甜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fresh figs are really sweet.

entries.example: 客人的資料都存在資料庫裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: All the customer data is stored in the database.
entries.question: 你的工作需要用資料庫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve using databases?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要查資料庫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I look things up in the database every day.

entries.example: 這個線上課程分成五個模組。
entries.exampleEnglish: This online course is divided into five modules.
entries.question: 你喜歡分成小模組的課程嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like courses split into small modules?
entries.answer: 喜歡，小模組比較容易學完。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, small modules are easier to finish.

entries.example: 她在公司裡的地位很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a high standing in the company.
entries.question: 在你的國家，老師的地位高嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do teachers have high status in your country?
entries.answer: 還不錯，老師的地位滿高的。
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. Teachers have fairly high status.

entries.example: 我們的團隊由五個人組成。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team is made up of five people.
entries.question: 你的家庭是由哪些人組成的？
entries.questionEnglish: Who makes up your family?
entries.answer: 我的家庭由爸媽、妹妹和我組成。
entries.answerEnglish: My family is made up of my parents, my younger sister and me.

entries.example: 這次調查有一千位受訪者。
entries.exampleEnglish: This survey had a thousand respondents.
entries.question: 你當過街頭訪問的受訪者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been interviewed in the street?
entries.answer: 當過，我在西門町當過受訪者。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was interviewed once in Ximending.

entries.example: 辦手機門號要帶身分證明文件。
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to bring ID to get a phone number.
entries.question: 你在台灣都用什麼當身分證明？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you use as ID in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我都用居留證當身分證明。
entries.answerEnglish: I use my residence permit as ID.

entries.example: 原告要求對方賠償十萬元。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plaintiff is asking for NT$100,000 in compensation.
entries.question: 打官司的時候，原告要準備什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What does a plaintiff need to prepare for a lawsuit?
entries.answer: 原告要準備好證據和文件。
entries.answerEnglish: The plaintiff needs to get evidence and documents ready.

entries.example: 他是這家咖啡店的創辦人。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the founder of this café.
entries.question: 你最欣賞哪家公司的創辦人？
entries.questionEnglish: Which company's founder do you admire most?
entries.answer: 我最欣賞蘋果公司的創辦人。
entries.answerEnglish: I admire Apple's founder the most.

entries.example: 這只是一個假設，還沒有證實。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just a hypothesis; it hasn't been proven yet.
entries.question: 假設你中了樂透，你想做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: Suppose you won the lottery. What would you do?
entries.answer: 假設我中了樂透，我會去環遊世界。
entries.answerEnglish: If I won the lottery, I'd travel around the world.

entries.example: 哈！我找到鑰匙了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Ha! I found my keys!
entries.question: 你常常說「哈哈」嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often say 'haha'?
entries.answer: 常常，覺得好笑的時候我就說哈哈。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. When something's funny, I say 'haha'.

entries.example: 感恩節的時候，我們家會吃火雞。
entries.exampleEnglish: At Thanksgiving my family eats turkey.
entries.question: 你吃過嘉義的火雞肉飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you tried Chiayi turkey rice?
entries.answer: 吃過，嘉義的火雞肉飯很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Chiayi turkey rice is delicious.

entries.example: 睡眠和心情有很大的關聯。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sleep and mood are closely connected.
entries.question: 你覺得天氣跟心情有關聯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think weather and mood are connected?
entries.answer: 有關聯，下雨天我就比較懶。
entries.answerEnglish: They are. I'm lazier on rainy days.

entries.example: 這次地震救出了十幾位倖存者。
entries.exampleEnglish: More than ten survivors were rescued after this earthquake.
entries.question: 災難的倖存者可以去哪裡找幫助？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can disaster survivors go for help?
entries.answer: 倖存者可以找社工或心理師幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Survivors can get help from social workers or counselors.

entries.example: 多喝水有助於消化。
entries.exampleEnglish: Drinking more water helps digestion.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼有助於學中文？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think helps with learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 看台灣的連續劇有助於學中文。
entries.answerEnglish: Watching Taiwanese dramas helps with learning Chinese.

entries.example: 請花五分鐘填寫這份問卷。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please take five minutes to fill out this questionnaire.
entries.question: 你常常在網路上填問卷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often fill out online surveys?
entries.answer: 偶爾會，有送禮物的問卷我會填。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I fill out the ones that give you a gift.

entries.example: 夜市裡有很多賣吃的小販。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of food vendors at the night market.
entries.question: 你常跟夜市的小販聊天嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often chat with night market vendors?
entries.answer: 會，我跟賣雞排的小販很熟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I know the fried chicken vendor well.

entries.example: 他確診以後，在家隔離了七天。
entries.exampleEnglish: After testing positive, he isolated at home for seven days.
entries.question: 為什麼生病的人有時候要隔離？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do sick people sometimes need to be isolated?
entries.answer: 因為隔離可以避免傳染給別人。
entries.answerEnglish: Because isolation stops it spreading to others.

entries.example: 這件外套很有功能性，可以防水又保暖。
entries.exampleEnglish: This jacket is very functional: it's waterproof and warm.
entries.question: 買包包時，你重視好看還是功能性？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a bag, do you care more about looks or function?
entries.answer: 我比較重視功能性，要能裝很多東西。
entries.answerEnglish: I care more about function. It has to hold a lot.

entries.example: 大家對這個問題的認知不一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: People see this issue differently.
entries.question: 來台灣以後，你對台灣的認知改變了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Since you came to Taiwan, has your understanding of it changed?
entries.answer: 改變很多，我對台灣的認知更深了。
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. My understanding of Taiwan is much deeper now.

entries.example: 爬完樓梯以後，我一直喘氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: After climbing the stairs, I couldn't stop panting.
entries.question: 你爬幾層樓梯就會開始喘氣？
entries.questionEnglish: How many flights of stairs can you climb before you start panting?
entries.answer: 我爬五層樓就會開始喘氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I start panting after five floors.

entries.example: 這件事不在我們分局的管轄範圍。
entries.exampleEnglish: This isn't within our precinct's jurisdiction.
entries.question: 你知道你家屬於哪個區公所的管轄範圍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which district office's jurisdiction your home falls under?
entries.answer: 知道，我家在大安區公所的管轄範圍。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my home is under the Da'an District Office's jurisdiction.

entries.example: 台北的人口密度非常高。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei's population density is very high.
entries.question: 你家鄉的人口密度高嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the population density high in your hometown?
entries.answer: 不高，我家鄉的人口密度很低。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my hometown's population density is low.

entries.example: 他們坐在門廊上喝咖啡聊天。
entries.exampleEnglish: They sat on the porch drinking coffee and chatting.
entries.question: 你老家的房子有門廊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your family home have a porch?
entries.answer: 有，我老家有一個很大的門廊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our family home has a big porch.

entries.example: 我的游泳教練很年輕。
entries.exampleEnglish: My swimming coach is very young.
entries.question: 你運動的時候會找教練嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work with a coach when you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我每個星期跟教練上一堂課。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a session with my trainer every week.

entries.example: 小提琴的琴弓不小心被我弄斷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally broke the violin bow.
entries.question: 你會用琴弓拉小提琴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the violin with a bow?
entries.answer: 不會，我連琴弓都拿不好。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't even hold the bow properly.

entries.example: 我想在台灣長期住下去。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like to live in Taiwan long-term.
entries.question: 你打算在台灣長期工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you planning to work in Taiwan long-term?
entries.answer: 對，我打算在台灣長期工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I plan to work in Taiwan long-term.

entries.example: 新的醫院院長是一位女醫生。
entries.exampleEnglish: The new hospital director is a female doctor.
entries.question: 你覺得當院長需要什麼能力？
entries.questionEnglish: What abilities do you think a dean needs?
entries.answer: 我覺得院長要很會管理。
entries.answerEnglish: I think a dean has to be good at management.

entries.example: 這座城堡以前屬於一位公爵。
entries.exampleEnglish: This castle once belonged to a duke.
entries.question: 你的國家現在還有公爵嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there still dukes in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我們國家現在還有幾位公爵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are still a few dukes in my country.

entries.example: 這個App的介面很簡單好用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This app's interface is simple and easy to use.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪個App的介面？
entries.questionEnglish: Which app's interface do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡LINE的介面，很簡單。
entries.answerEnglish: I like LINE's interface best. It's simple.

entries.example: 她很有天分，學什麼都很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very gifted and picks everything up quickly.
entries.question: 你覺得自己在哪方面有天分？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think you're gifted at?
entries.answer: 我覺得我在語言方面有天分。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I have a gift for languages.

entries.example: 他送我一束紅玫瑰。
entries.exampleEnglish: He gave me a bunch of red roses.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼顏色的玫瑰？
entries.questionEnglish: What color roses do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡白色的玫瑰。
entries.answerEnglish: I like white roses best.

entries.example: 我媽媽是一個很樂觀的人。
entries.exampleEnglish: My mom is a very optimistic person.
entries.question: 你是個樂觀的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you an optimistic person?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿樂觀的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty optimistic.

entries.example: 動物園裡有三隻狼。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are three wolves at the zoo.
entries.question: 你看過真的狼嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a real wolf?
entries.answer: 看過，我在加拿大看過狼。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw wolves in Canada.

entries.example: 去別人家吃飯要注意禮儀。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mind your manners when you eat at someone's home.
entries.question: 在台灣吃飯有什麼禮儀要注意？
entries.questionEnglish: What dining etiquette should you know about in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 筷子不能插在飯上，這是基本禮儀。
entries.answerEnglish: Don't stick your chopsticks upright in the rice; that's basic etiquette.

entries.example: 他有很多當領導的特質。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a lot of the qualities of a leader.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有什麼好的特質？
entries.questionEnglish: What good traits do you think you have?
entries.answer: 我覺得我最好的特質是有耐心。
entries.answerEnglish: I think my best trait is patience.

entries.example: 這家公司的規模越來越大。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company keeps getting bigger.
entries.question: 你的公司規模大不大？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your company big?
entries.answer: 我們公司規模不大，大概五十個人。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company isn't big; it has about fifty people.

entries.example: 在捷運上要遵守規定，不能吃東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: You have to follow the rules on the MRT: no eating.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人很遵守交通規則嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people follow the traffic rules well?
entries.answer: 大部分的人都很遵守交通規則。
entries.answerEnglish: Most people follow the traffic rules well.

entries.example: 你可以在設定裡調整這些參數。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can adjust these parameters in the settings.
entries.question: 你拍照的時候會自己調參數嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you adjust the settings yourself when you take photos?
entries.answer: 會，我常自己調相機的參數。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often adjust the camera's settings myself.

entries.example: 老鷹是很厲害的掠食者。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eagles are formidable predators.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種動物是最可怕的掠食者？
entries.questionEnglish: Which animal do you think is the scariest predator?
entries.answer: 我覺得鱷魚是最可怕的掠食者。
entries.answerEnglish: I think crocodiles are the scariest predators.

entries.example: 很多宗教節日現在都變得很世俗。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many religious holidays have become very secular.
entries.question: 你在乎世俗的眼光嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care what society thinks?
entries.answer: 不太在乎，我不想活在世俗的眼光裡。
entries.answerEnglish: Not much. I don't want to live by what society thinks.

entries.example: 冬天流感的發生率比較高。
entries.exampleEnglish: The incidence of flu is higher in winter.
entries.question: 哪個季節感冒的發生率比較高？
entries.questionEnglish: Which season has a higher incidence of colds?
entries.answer: 冬天感冒的發生率比較高。
entries.answerEnglish: Colds are more common in winter.

entries.example: 這個說法沒有實證的支持。
entries.exampleEnglish: This claim has no empirical support.
entries.question: 你相信沒有實證的偏方嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in folk remedies with no empirical evidence?
entries.answer: 不相信，我只相信有實證的方法。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I only trust methods backed by evidence.

entries.example: 這個問題可以用矩陣來計算。
entries.exampleEnglish: This problem can be worked out with a matrix.
entries.question: 你以前學過矩陣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever studied matrices?
entries.answer: 學過，可是我已經忘了矩陣怎麼算。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I've forgotten how to work with matrices.

entries.example: 老闆肯定了我們這次的努力。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss recognized our hard work this time.
entries.question: 你覺得在工作上被肯定重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think recognition at work is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，被肯定讓我更有動力。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Being recognized motivates me more.

entries.example: 開車的時候不要分心看手機。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't get distracted by your phone while driving.
entries.question: 工作的時候，什麼最容易讓你分心？
entries.questionEnglish: What distracts you most easily at work?
entries.answer: 手機通知最容易讓我分心。
entries.answerEnglish: Phone notifications distract me the most.

entries.example: 這台筆電的規格很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: This laptop has high specs.
entries.question: 買手機的時候，你會比較規格嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a phone, do you compare the specs?
entries.answer: 會，我會先比較規格再買。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I compare the specs before I buy.

entries.example: 這本中文教科書很實用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This Chinese textbook is very practical.
entries.question: 你現在用哪本中文教科書？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese textbook are you using now?
entries.answer: 我用語言中心發的教科書。
entries.answerEnglish: I use the textbook the language center gave us.

entries.example: 這座老廟體現了台灣的傳統文化。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old temple embodies Taiwan's traditional culture.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼最能體現台灣文化？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think best embodies Taiwanese culture?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市最能體現台灣文化。
entries.answerEnglish: I think night markets best embody Taiwanese culture.

entries.example: 這本筆記本有格線，寫字很整齊。
entries.exampleEnglish: This notebook has grid lines, so your writing stays neat.
entries.question: 你喜歡用有格線的筆記本嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like notebooks with grid lines?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有格線的筆記本比較好寫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, notebooks with grid lines are easier to write in.

entries.example: 點一下右上角的圖示就可以了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Just tap the icon in the top right corner.
entries.question: 你的手機桌面有很多圖示嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of icons on your phone's home screen?
entries.answer: 有，我的桌面有幾十個圖示。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are dozens of icons on my home screen.

entries.example: 他跪下來向女朋友求婚。
entries.exampleEnglish: He knelt down and proposed to his girlfriend.
entries.question: 在你的國家，求婚要跪下嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do people kneel to propose?
entries.answer: 要，很多男生會跪下來求婚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of men kneel down to propose.

entries.example: 下雨天我傾向搭捷運，不想騎車。
entries.exampleEnglish: On rainy days I tend to take the MRT rather than ride.
entries.question: 旅行時，你傾向自由行還是跟團？
entries.questionEnglish: When you travel, do you lean toward going independently or joining a tour?
entries.answer: 我傾向自由行，比較自由。
entries.answerEnglish: I lean toward independent travel; it's freer.

entries.example: 台北的交通很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: Getting around Taipei is very convenient.
entries.question: 你家附近交通方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is it easy to get around near your home?
entries.answer: 很方便，走路五分鐘就到捷運站。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. The MRT station is a five-minute walk away.

entries.example: 這個月的業績達到目標了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This month's sales hit the target.
entries.question: 你今年的目標達到了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you reached your goals this year?
entries.answer: 還沒，希望年底可以達到。
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I hope to by the end of the year.

entries.example: 這條小路鋪滿了碎石。
entries.exampleEnglish: This path is covered in gravel.
entries.question: 你騎腳踏車騎過碎石路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever biked on a gravel road?
entries.answer: 騎過，碎石路很不好騎。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, gravel roads are hard to ride on.

entries.example: 她去髮廊把頭髮拉直了。
entries.exampleEnglish: She went to the salon and had her hair straightened.
entries.question: 你想過把頭髮拉直嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thought about straightening your hair?
entries.answer: 想過，可是拉直頭髮很貴。
entries.answerEnglish: I have, but hair straightening is expensive.

entries.example: 這幅畫只是複製品，不是真跡。
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is only a reproduction, not the original.
entries.question: 你家裡有名畫的複製品嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any reproductions of famous paintings at home?
entries.answer: 有，我客廳掛了一幅梵谷的複製品。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a Van Gogh reproduction in my living room.

entries.example: 這家餐廳用機器人送餐。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant uses robots to bring the food.
entries.question: 你家有掃地機器人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a robot vacuum at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一台掃地機器人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a robot vacuum.

entries.example: 租房子之前要先看清楚契約。
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the contract carefully before you rent a place.
entries.question: 你租房子的時候有簽契約嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you sign a contract when you rented your place?
entries.answer: 有，我簽了一年的契約。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I signed a one-year contract.

entries.example: 加一點水，調整醬汁的濃稠度。
entries.exampleEnglish: Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the sauce.
entries.question: 你喜歡濃稠度高的粥嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like thick congee?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡濃稠度高一點的粥。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like my congee a bit thicker.

entries.example: 審計員下週會來公司查帳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The auditors are coming to check the books next week.
entries.question: 你覺得審計員的工作辛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an auditor's job is hard?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，審計員常常要加班。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Auditors often have to work overtime.

entries.example: 我弟弟是大學生。
entries.exampleEnglish: My younger brother is a college student.
entries.question: 你當大學生的時候住在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you live when you were in college?
entries.answer: 我當大學生的時候住在宿舍。
entries.answerEnglish: I lived in a dorm when I was in college.

entries.example: 這部電影是改編自一本小說。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is adapted from a novel.
entries.question: 你看過哪部改編自小說的電影？
entries.questionEnglish: Which movie adapted from a novel have you seen?
entries.answer: 我看過《哈利波特》，是小說改編的。
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen Harry Potter; it was adapted from a novel.

entries.example: 這台舊電腦啟動要等兩分鐘。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old computer takes two minutes to start up.
entries.question: 你的電腦啟動要多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long does your computer take to start up?
entries.answer: 我的電腦啟動大概要三十秒。
entries.answerEnglish: My computer takes about thirty seconds to start up.

entries.example: 這部西部片的主角是一位警長。
entries.exampleEnglish: The hero of this Western is a sheriff.
entries.question: 你小時候想當警長嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a sheriff when you were little?
entries.answer: 想過，我小時候很想當警長。
entries.answerEnglish: I did. I really wanted to be a sheriff as a kid.

entries.example: 馬偕是台灣很有名的傳教士。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mackay is a very famous missionary in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你在台灣的路上看過傳教士嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen missionaries on the streets in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我常看到騎腳踏車的傳教士。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often see missionaries on bicycles.

entries.example: 他用手指戳了我一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: He poked me with his finger.
entries.question: 你想叫朋友的時候會戳他嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you poke your friends to get their attention?
entries.answer: 會，我會戳一下他的肩膀。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I poke them on the shoulder.

entries.example: 我太依賴手機了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I rely on my phone too much.
entries.question: 你覺得自己很依賴手機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you depend on your phone a lot?
entries.answer: 對，我出門很依賴手機導航。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rely on my phone's navigation when I go out.

entries.example: 動物園裡有兩隻老虎。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are two tigers at the zoo.
entries.question: 你在動物園看過老虎嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen tigers at the zoo?
entries.answer: 看過，那隻老虎好大。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that tiger was huge.

entries.english: straight line; in a straight line
entries.example: 從這裡直線走過去就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Just walk straight on from here and you're there.
entries.question: 你不用尺能畫出直線嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you draw a straight line without a ruler?
entries.answer: 不能，我不用尺畫不出直線。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't draw a straight line without one.

entries.example: 我想要靠走道的位子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like an aisle seat.
entries.question: 坐飛機時，你喜歡靠窗還是靠走道？
entries.questionEnglish: On a plane, do you prefer the window or the aisle?
entries.answer: 我喜歡靠走道，上廁所比較方便。
entries.answerEnglish: I like the aisle; it's easier to get to the restroom.

entries.english: speechless; at a loss for words
entries.example: 我感動得說不出話。
entries.exampleEnglish: I was so moved I couldn't speak.
entries.question: 什麼事讓你驚訝得說不出話？
entries.questionEnglish: What has ever left you speechless with surprise?
entries.answer: 第一次看到太魯閣，我驚訝得說不出話。
entries.answerEnglish: The first time I saw Taroko Gorge, I was speechless.

entries.example: 這條溪的水很清澈。
entries.exampleEnglish: The water in this stream is very clear.
entries.question: 你去過海水很清澈的地方嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been anywhere with really clear sea water?
entries.answer: 去過，墾丁的海水很清澈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the sea in Kenting is really clear.

entries.example: 飛機開始下降了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plane has started its descent.
entries.question: 最近你那裡的氣溫下降了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has the temperature dropped where you are lately?
entries.answer: 有，這幾天氣溫下降很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's dropped a lot in the past few days.

entries.example: 手機的功能進化得非常快。
entries.exampleEnglish: Phone features are evolving very quickly.
entries.question: 你覺得十年後手機會怎麼進化？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you think phones will evolve in ten years?
entries.answer: 我覺得手機會進化成眼鏡。
entries.answerEnglish: I think phones will evolve into glasses.

entries.english: be literate; be able to read; literacy
entries.example: 我奶奶不識字，但是很聰明。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma can't read, but she's very smart.
entries.question: 你覺得識字對生活重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being able to read matters in everyday life?
entries.answer: 很重要，不識字很多事都不方便。
entries.answerEnglish: Very. If you can't read, lots of things are hard to do.

entries.example: 吃完飯以後，大家各自回家。
entries.exampleEnglish: After dinner, everyone went their own way home.
entries.question: 你和室友會各自煮飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you and your roommate cook separately?
entries.answer: 會，我們都各自煮飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we each cook for ourselves.

entries.example: 這個展覽可以跟作品互動。
entries.exampleEnglish: At this exhibition you can interact with the works.
entries.question: 你跟同事的互動好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you get along with your coworkers?
entries.answer: 很好，我跟同事常常互動。
entries.answerEnglish: Well. I interact with my coworkers a lot.

entries.example: 這部影集的劇情很有連貫性。
entries.exampleEnglish: The plot of this series has good continuity.
entries.question: 你看影集時在意劇情的連貫性嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care about plot continuity when you watch a series?
entries.answer: 很在意，沒有連貫性我就看不下去。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. Without continuity I can't keep watching.

entries.example: 冬天脫毛衣的時候常有靜電。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's often static when you take off a sweater in winter.
entries.question: 冬天你常常被靜電電到嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get static shocks in winter?
entries.answer: 常常，我摸門把常被靜電電到。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I get shocks when I touch door handles.

entries.example: 水族館裡有一隻很大的鯊魚。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a huge shark in the aquarium.
entries.question: 你在海裡看過鯊魚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a shark in the sea?
entries.answer: 沒有，我只在水族館看過鯊魚。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've only seen sharks in aquariums.

entries.example: 咖啡是我早上不可或缺的飲料。
entries.exampleEnglish: Coffee is an essential part of my morning.
entries.question: 你生活中有什麼不可或缺的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What's indispensable in your life?
entries.answer: 手機是我生活中不可或缺的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: My phone is indispensable in my life.

entries.example: 這間小套房的空間配置很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This small studio has a good layout.
entries.question: 租房子時，你會注意空間配置嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you rent a place, do you pay attention to the layout?
entries.answer: 會，空間配置好，住起來比較舒服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a good layout makes a place more comfortable to live in.

entries.example: 台灣的地形大部分是山。
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of Taiwan's terrain is mountainous.
entries.question: 你家鄉是什麼樣的地形？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the terrain like in your hometown?
entries.answer: 我家鄉的地形很平，沒有山。
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is flat, with no mountains.

entries.example: 下雨以後，外面有很多青蛙在叫。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, lots of frogs are croaking outside.
entries.question: 你小時候抓過青蛙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever catch frogs as a kid?
entries.answer: 抓過，我小時候常在河邊抓青蛙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often caught frogs by the river when I was little.

entries.example: 這間教堂有三位神職人員。
entries.exampleEnglish: This church has three members of the clergy.
entries.question: 神職人員平常要做哪些工作？
entries.questionEnglish: What work do members of the clergy usually do?
entries.answer: 神職人員要主持儀式和照顧信徒。
entries.answerEnglish: Clergy lead services and look after the faithful.
